identity.completeness: ID-1: frozen canonical INCI treated as complete; no material conflict (ID-3: 'Provitamin B5' -> Panthenol #11 present; 'silikonfrei' consistent with INCI; 'AuraBoost' fragrance is a note only).

cleansingStrength.rationale: C1: defining anionic Sodium Laureth Sulfate #2 (ether type, C3); prominent buffers Coco-Glucoside #3 (nonionic glucoside) and Cocamidopropyl Betaine #4 (amphoteric); no reinforcing strong anionic (C4) -> moderate. Counter-signals toward low (Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil #7, Glyceryl Oleate #8 refatting) recorded but do not move the convention; a low call is unrealistic with SLES as primary surfactant and strong is excluded by two buffers and no reinforcing route.

conditioningLevel.rationale: C2 not met (no early silicone; Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil #7 can stand in for the silicone but there is no separate pearlizing/fatty route). The high anchor is reached through W-RICH instead: prominent payload_lipid Hydrogenated Vegetable Oil #7 (waxy) converges with prominent cationic polymer Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #9; W-RICH alone counts as rich architecture for conditioningLevel. Supporting: Glyceryl Oleate #8 (weak refatter), Panthenol #11 (humectant). Counter-signal: no silicone, no fatty alcohol/pearlizer, both depositing routes listed after Sodium Chloride #6 (bounded amounts) -> moderate confidence, neighbor moderate. 'reichhaltige Formel' claim ignored (C7, 3.2).

excluded: Sorbitan Caprylate #10 (short-chain C8 sorbitan ester, preservative booster/solubilizer, not a persistent lipid)
Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil #16, Citrus Limon Peel Oil #17 (fragrance oils, 6.4)
Acid Blue 9 #21, Acid Violet 43 #22 (toning dyes, not conditioning deposition)

weightPotential.depositionLoad: moderate - one prominent cationic guar plus a prominent waxy lipid and a weak refatter; no silicone.
weightPotential.persistence: moderate - hydrogenated (waxy) lipid is more substantive than a liquid oil; guar is a single light-to-moderate polymer; no persistent silicone system.
weightPotential.resetCapacity: moderate - C1 sulfate chassis (SLES #2) with two prominent buffers; effective ordinary cleansing, not limited.
weightPotential.counterevidence: Toward high: W-RICH (prominent payload lipid + cationic polymer). Toward low: no silicone, both depositing routes after salt, ordinary C1 reset.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: Two interacting depositing families (guar + waxy lipid, plus weak refatter) plausibly leave noticeable but bounded residue; reset is effective ordinary.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not high: W-RICH is present but reset is moderate, not limited (W-RICH limited-reset clause), and only two converging families with no silicone and modest prominence do not establish a heavy/coating result. Not low (W2): two prominent deposition families are present, neither late/trace, so calling it lightweight would understate residue risk.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Amounts of HVO and guar unknown from INCI order; W-RICH makes high the realistic neighbor.
weightPotential.rationale: Full 6.6 method (W1 not applicable: no silicone/amodimethicone set). depositionLoad moderate, persistence moderate, resetCapacity moderate -> moderate. W-RICH with resetCapacity moderate is not limited reset, so per W-RICH the band is moderate with W-RICH as counter-signal and high as neighbor (N-ALT). W2 satisfied for not-low. Claims ('reichhaltig') never raise (6.5 step 5).

careDirection.limitation: Single humectant (Panthenol) is not a coherent humectant cluster; generic conditioning distinguishes neither moisture nor repair.

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Manufacturer claim 'strahlendes, hydratisiertes, gelbstichfreies Blond' (moderate, CL-SRC) with 'Provitamin B5' points to moisture, but the hydration claim is footnoted to the complete routine incl. mask and the formula verdict is nonspecific.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Claim direction: dominant job is yellow-tone neutralization/toning (violet pigments), which is not a focus value; secondary wording 'strahlend' (colour brightness) and 'hydratisiert' (routine-dependent). Formula compatible with moisture? Verdict nonspecific (F1) -> moisture cannot be assigned from claims (3.2). Shine not positioned as gloss/smoothness. Retailer range copy ('Reduziert Haarbruch') is range-level/low grade (E1, CL-SRC). Decision: general (7.2 'unsupported/generic claims').
focusPrimary.rationale: 7.2 + F1: toning is the dominant job and is outside the focus vocabulary; moisture claim sits on a nonspecific formula -> general. Moderate because the moisture claim is manufacturer-graded.

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered and kept: no distinct secondary positioning with an independent route (Section 8). 'hydratisiert' rests only on Panthenol #11 with a nonspecific verdict; 'strahlend' is a toning outcome, not a shine route; citric acid is a pH adjuster (F4).
focusSecondary.rationale: Section 8, F3, F4: no qualifying secondary.

usageRole.rationale: Default regular (Section 9). frequent: no U2 wording. alternating: cleansing not strong; retailer 'abwechselnd mit deinem regulären Shampoo verwenden' is retailer-only (low, CL-SRC) and cannot fire. occasional_reset: D1 judged false - manufacturer direction 'Wöchentlich oder nach Bedarf anwenden, um Gelbstich zu neutralisieren' is a toning cadence with 'nach Bedarf', not a limitation to occasional resets, and no D1 lexicon stem appears. Moderate confidence because the weekly direction is close to D1's '1x pro Woche' example.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: No E2 sensitive or dry scalp claim unit (SC1); 'ohne auszutrocknen' (retailer) is protective hair wording (E2a). Complete ordinary formula -> not_targeted.

dandruffSupport.rationale: Complete INCI contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole.
